name: find_code
description: Find relevant code snippets related to a keyword (e.g., function name, class name, or content).

graph_name.description: Optional: Name of the FalkorDB graph to query. Each indexed repository can have its own graph. Use 'list_graphs' to see available graphs. Defaults to the server's configured graph name.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for

repo_path.description: Optional: Path to the repository to restrict the search to.
